remaining_obligations: Prove reachable character/costume selector ranges and missing-file exclusions.

Map every generic queued menu/stage/sprite request to its destination and partition mode. Large assets include SEL_SPR.BIN880640 sector-rounded bytes and TEST_SPR.BIN1189888; dynamic scratch destinations may overlap this candidate.

targeted_next_metadata.selected_iso_paths: The 86 existing DOA2/*.CHR files in the verified filesystem; no whole assets are exported.
targeted_next_metadata.conditions: All offsets/counts are little-endian observations; ranges must be aligned, disjoint from header/each other, in-file, and within explicit count/byte/global caps before table reads.
targeted_next_metadata.exports: Header words and bounded integer pointer/record fields with offsets/counts and SHA256 hashes. Unknown layouts retain header metadata and an unavailable reason.
targeted_next_metadata.why_needed: Original character/stage CHR consumers derive pointer-table and record destinations from these five words. File byte lengths alone do not establish those accesses.
targeted_next_metadata.safe_lease_after_collection: Not automatic; source mode/lifetime and remaining owner proof must still be completed.
